description: A kneeling man inclines toward a seated woman in Rodin’s compact marble group. Her upright pose contrasts with the diagonal of his body, creating a tension between closeness and distance. This 1893 marble was executed by Jean Escoula and later entered Harvard’s Fogg Museum through the Winthrop bequest.
